translations.web: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
translations.bsb: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
translations.kjv: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
translations.asv: They have dealt treacherously against Jehovah; for they have borne strange children: now shall the new moon devour them with their fields.
